description: ...[Darren] is brilliant and has strong, solid creative ideas. He is also able to listen to others and include everyone....He is a leader who is easy to follow. I am so glad Darren has chosen to offer to serve in the UT house. I encourage all in his district to both vote and support Darren, because I truly believe everyone in Utah will benefit by his contribution in that role.
title: Mary Schwartz - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
